skill.name: ad-creative
skill.description: Generate grounded, platform-ready ad copy, static concepts, and video ad scripts from product context, customer evidence, and performance data.
skill.summary: Create and iterate ad creative at scale while checking platform limits, grounding claims, and organizing outputs for testing.
skill.author: coreyhaines31

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown syntax, documentation links, URL text, and environment-variable placeholders. No prompt injection or credential exfiltration was found. However, the references recommend unpinned third-party execution and native-interface imitation, creating supply-chain and deception risks.

remediation.issue: The guide executes an unpinned package through `npx`.
remediation.suggestion: Pin an audited package version, document its source, and require explicit user confirmation before installation or execution.

remediation.issue: The guide runs build targets from an unpinned cloned repository.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed commit, inspect the Makefile, verify repository integrity, and require confirmation before running setup or development targets.

remediation.issue: Native interface replicas can obscure that content is an advertisement.
remediation.suggestion: Default to generic interface skins, add an in-creative dramatization label, and prohibit fabricated endorsements or regulated advice.

content.user_title: Create Platform-Ready Ad Creative at Scale
content.value_statement: Ad teams need many distinct variations without losing brand accuracy or platform compliance. This skill creates grounded copy, visual concepts, and test-ready batches.
actual_capabilities: Generates headlines, descriptions, primary text, and complete variations for major paid advertising platforms.
Develops distinct creative angles based on audience needs, product benefits, proof, urgency, and positioning.
Analyzes supplied performance data and creates new variations from winning themes while avoiding weak patterns.
Checks copy against documented platform character limits and provides trimmed alternatives for oversized text.
Builds grounded static ad batches from winning ads, customer reviews, comments, brand assets, and reusable templates.
Drafts native reveal and faceless motion video concepts with scripts, pacing, visual prompts, and production guidance.
limitations: It does not choose campaign budgets, targeting, platform allocation, or complete advertising strategy.
Reliable output requires product facts, brand rules, customer evidence, or performance data from the user.
It cannot independently verify claims, legal compliance, current platform policies, vendor pricing, or licensing terms.
It does not publish campaigns or create final media unless compatible external tools are configured and approved.

use_cases.title: Refresh Winning Campaign Creative
use_cases.description: Analyze recent ad metrics and generate controlled variations that extend proven themes while testing a small number of new angles.

use_cases.title: Produce Grounded Static Batches
use_cases.description: Turn reviews, comments, winning ads, and brand assets into sourced concepts across varied static templates.

use_cases.title: Launch Platform-Specific Ads
use_cases.description: Create compliant starting sets for Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, or X from a clear product brief.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Starter Ad Set
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner creation from a product brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Create ads for [product] on [platform]. Target [audience] with [offer]. Use [brand voice] and avoid unsupported claims.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt One Offer Across Platforms
prompt_templates.prompt: Adapt this offer for Google, Meta, LinkedIn, and TikTok. Create three angles per platform and respect each format limit: [offer details].

prompt_templates.title: Iterate From Performance Data
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these ads using [primary metric]. Identify winning and weak patterns, then generate controlled variations with one test variable each: [performance data].

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Grounded Creative Batch
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced static and video concept production
prompt_templates.prompt: Create 30 sourced concepts from these reviews, comments, winning ads, and brand rules. Mix static templates and video formats: [grounded inputs].

output_examples.input: A reporting tool needs Google responsive search ads for finance teams that spend hours preparing weekly reports.
output: Angle: Time savings. Fifteen independent headlines emphasize faster reporting without inventing performance claims.
Four descriptions add proof placeholders, objection handling, and clear trial actions within documented limits.
A validation section lists character counts and trimmed alternatives.

output_examples.input: Meta performance data shows customer-review hooks outperform feature announcements by 38 percent.
output: The analysis identifies customer language and specific outcomes as the strongest patterns.
New concepts extend review-led hooks while testing one comparison angle and one objection angle.
Each variation names its source pattern and intended test variable.

output_examples.input: A consumer subscription brand provides reviews, comments, five winning ads, and complete visual guidelines.
output: A batch index summarizes 30 sourced concepts across review cards, comparisons, FAQs, founder messages, and motion ideas.
Each concept includes copy, visual direction, grounding source, placement, and claim-review notes.

best_practices: Provide verified product facts, brand rules, winning ads, reviews, and comments before requesting large creative batches.
Choose one primary performance metric and change one meaningful variable per test cycle.
Review every claim, disclaimer, testimonial, native-interface concept, and generated asset before publishing.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for budget allocation, audience targeting, or complete campaign strategy.
Do not invent statistics, testimonials, product outcomes, urgency, or customer language when evidence is unavailable.
Do not judge variations while changing several angles, formats, offers, and audiences in the same test.

faq.question: Which advertising platforms are supported?
faq.answer: The guidance covers Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, and X, with additional references for common image and video placements.

faq.question: Can it analyze existing ad performance?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide copy and metrics such as click-through rate, conversion rate, or return on ad spend.

faq.question: Can it generate finished images or videos?
faq.answer: It creates concepts, scripts, prompts, and production plans. Finished media requires configured and approved image or video tools.

faq.question: Does it publish ads or change campaigns?
faq.answer: No. It prepares creative outputs and references optional integrations, but campaign changes require separate tools and user approval.

faq.question: How does it reduce invented claims?
faq.answer: Grounded modes require source material and connect every concept to a review, comment, winning ad, or verified product fact.

faq.question: Does it replace legal or platform compliance review?
faq.answer: No. Users must verify claims, disclosures, testimonials, licensing, trade dress, regulated advice, and current platform requirements.
